title: Compressed nine-stage E8 windows and whole-block banking for a conditional κ = 9.98243154231047e-4 > 2^-10 bound
body:
## Change and mathematical scope

This combines the local E8 bit word from #370 with the nine-stage complex component from #377 and supplies a new compressed nine-stage bit construction. The resulting **conditional** bound is

**κ = 998243154231047 / 10^18 = 9.98243154231047e-4 ≈ 2^-9.9683211064 > 2^-10.**

The excess over `1/1024` is exactly `21680654231047 / 10^18`. This is approximately **24.0286%** above the frozen #361 combined value. The complex supplier now binds; this is no longer the bit-side-pending projection in #377. No claim of priority is made.

### Construction

- Reproduce #370 at `b7fe9cdf2da009c947ff6b334c562bc190b30373`, including its original word, regeneration, independent F₂ checker, official record/formal-column checks, exact geometry, negative controls and regressions. Its original five-stage bit saving alone is insufficient to cross `2^-10` with #377.
- Lift that local word into nine windows in `Q^8 ⊕ (Q^7)^8`, so `m = 64`. Use four data pairs, eight replicas and 7,785 whole-block helper banks, with 15,465 live families and nine reserved private copy slots. Each bank contains eight rank-8 residuals and needs no padding child.
- Defer endpoint completion until the final stage. Exact port isometries align complete frames at every bridge. Reflected calls use the actual reversed record stream and a freshly derived rank-8 COPY; they do not invert erasure.
- Retain #377's exact complex Clifford/Z₄ checks, terminal `X_q` and every-live-family `X_delta(g)` signed phase corrections. Binary matrix equality alone is not used to identify complex operators.

| Quantity | Exact certified value |
| --- | --- |
| New bit coarse saving | `1057833103534317 / 10^18` |
| Complex coarse saving | `999240641319551 / 10^18` |
| Selected capped bit saving | `999240640320309 / 10^18` |
| Final conditional κ after three bootstrap steps | `998243154231047 / 10^18` |

The bit maximum child is `42/64`, so the proof uses and charges **two-level** halving: `2*42² < 64²`. The actual nine-stage payload prefix needs 117 bits; it receives a 192-bit allowance rather than reusing the old five-stage 104-bit guard. The two-level finite coefficient has 269 bits and is charged 512 bits. Its row coefficient is 18,355, below the inherited 20,161 allowance. See `research/e8-bit-complex-nine/PROOF.txt` for the cover-owner, arbitrary-dirty-bank, precision and finite-cost arguments.

## Validation

Run `make e8-bit-complex-nine-verify`, or choose a fresh nonexistent output directory:

```sh
python3 -B research/e8-bit-complex-nine/verify.py --work /tmp/e8-bit-complex-nine-fresh
```

Requirements: Python 3.11+, NumPy, SymPy, mpmath, a C++17 compiler and Boost headers. The standard-header shim permits Clang without changing the pinned upstream sources. The complete source and dependency manifests are checked before rebuilding.

Fresh validation receipts are included in `research/e8-bit-complex-nine-validation/`. They cover the complete #370 and #377 reconstruction followed by the new exact geometry, source-bound emitted program, separate template audit and rational assembly:

- all 120 port routes and 944 exact local frame projectors;
- all 3,289 nested and reflected frame pairs;
- 8,745 independent scalar columns, 62,280 bank assignments and 72 local invocations;
- 1,355,328 emitted local events and the literal child profile;
- 18 omitted-shear controls and eight structural template mutations, plus inherited negative controls;
- two rational moment engines with the `10^-16` fallback, all 47 positive strict outer constraints, and rejection of the adjacent bit-saving and final-κ grid points.

The earlier `make complex-nine-verify` and unchanged `make gen4-bank-verify` passed. The full historical `make verify` stopped on the unchanged pinned base at `verify-strips/skip-suffix`: Apple `clang++` rejects `-fopenmp`. A full historical-suite pass is not claimed.

### Scope and attribution

This remains a **conditional finite construction**, not a new Lean proof of the complete multiplication theorem. The all-size weighted compiler, prime/tape/precision, common-grid/restored-row and analytic-transfer interfaces remain explicit inherited obligations. #370's admission of nine copied totals at `h = 8` is retained. Neither the whole astronomical orthogonal cover nor an independent human review is claimed by these finite checks.

The local E8 bit word is Dylan Crow's contribution, with Anthropic Claude assistance, from #370. Jacob Sussman's E8 unit and all upstream licenses and notices are preserved. The compressed bit composition, independent audit and combined package were prepared by Zhihao Chen with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance under Apache-2.0. #377's existing complex commit is included in this branch so the combined PR can be reproduced independently of whether either dependency has merged.
